work.author: United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of South Carolina
work.description: The bankruptcy court's judgment against Jim Bakker in the PTL ministry's estate. Its concluding section applies Galatians 6:7 - the verse the 1962 Missal appoints at the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost - as the operative sentence of a money judgment. A locus is a printed page of 92 B.R.
work.title: Benton v. Bakker (In re Heritage Village Church & Missionary Fellowship, Inc.), 92 B.R. 1000 (1988)
